🚐 No press gallery for this one. Just twenty-five minibuses that started work this month — and a bill that's been eating Lancashire alive.

Getting children with special educational needs to and from school is set to cost Lancashire County Council £61m this financial year. Not on teaching. Not on therapy. On the journey.

So instead of renting the service forever, we bought it:
✅ 50 specialist minibuses
✅ Fleet now 208 vehicles
✅ Around 30% lower cost per pupil where they're deployed
✅ 25 on the roads from September

And the honest bit: they were ordered eighteen months ago, and half the fleet still isn't in service. That's too slow, and I'd rather say it myself than have someone else say it for me.

Run the council like it's spending your money — because it is. 👇
